title: Static stability using Availability Zones
author: Becky Weiss and Mike Furr (Amazon Builders' Library)
why: The primary source for static stability: how EC2 separates control and data planes and why AWS pre-provisions capacity across zones.

title: Avoiding fallback in distributed systems
author: Jacob Gabrielson (Amazon Builders' Library)
why: Why a rarely exercised fallback path can cause the outage it was meant to prevent, and the alternatives Amazon prefers.

title: Addressing Cascading Failures (Site Reliability Engineering, chapter 22)
author: Google
why: How one overloaded component takes down its neighbours, and the degradation and load-shedding responses that stop it.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann (O'Reilly)
why: Chapter 1 defines faults versus failures and explains hardware, software and human faults and why correlated software faults are the hardest.
